title: Epic's Tim Sweeney calls Steam's AI label unfair 🏷️
subject: steam
description:
Should stores label games made with AI? 👇

In a GamesBeat interview, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney said Steam's AI disclosure label is unfair to developers who use AI to make good games and called it a guilt by association pattern. Former Valve developer Chet Faliszek responded on YouTube.

Sources: GamesRadar+ (Nov 14, 2026), MP1st (Nov 14, 2026), GamesBeat interview

scenes.text: Tim Sweeney says Steam's AI label is unfair.
scenes.search: pc gaming setup monitor dark room

scenes.text: Valve requires developers to disclose AI-generated content.
The Epic CEO told GamesBeat that tying AI to bad games is unfair to developers who use it well.
He called the label a guilt by association pattern. Reviews, he argued, already tell players about quality.
He warned that teams skipping AI will be left behind, as rivals get four, maybe 10 times more efficient.
Former Valve developer Chet Faliszek fired back on YouTube, calling it AI psychosis.
